User-agent: *

# Allow pagination pages (must come BEFORE the ? block)
Allow: /*?page=

# Block ALL other GET parameters
Disallow: /*?

# Block known unwanted params (kept for clarity)
Disallow: /*?asc=
Disallow: /*?desc=
Disallow: /*?ptype=
Disallow: /*?default=
Disallow: /*?S=
Disallow: /*?p=
Disallow: /*?fl=
Disallow: /*?sumsub_res=
Disallow: /*&asc=
Disallow: /*&desc=
Disallow: /*&ptype=
Disallow: /*&default=
Disallow: /*&S=
Disallow: /*&p=
Disallow: /*&fl=
Disallow: /*&sumsub_res=

# Block unwanted paths
Disallow: /*/processPayment/
Disallow: /*/products/getDescription/
Disallow: /*/feedbacks/show/
Disallow: /*/products/buy/
